rounds.text: Valencia Nutrition Ltd is undergoing a massive capital expenditure phase, evidenced by Capital Work in Progress (CWIP) exploding by 5892.9% to reach ₹ 8.39 Cr by March 2026 [E34]. This heavy investment underpins extraordinary multi-year top-line expansion, boasting a 10-year compounded sales growth of 33%, a 5-year rate of 48%, and a blistering 3-year rate of 66% [E12, E13, E14]. This momentum is further highlighted by recent screens showing a massive 338% year-over-year sales surge alongside profit growth exceeding 20% YoY [E58, E61]. The business is clearly outperforming the broader sector median sales growth of 11.8% by a wide margin [E70]. Conceded: trailing twelve months sales growth has contracted by -22% and earnings growth is decelerating [E15, E62].

Conceded: the bull correctly highlights the multi-year top-line expansion with a 10-year compounded sales growth of 33%, a 5-year rate of 48%, and a 3-year rate of 66% [E12, E13, E14], as well as outperforming the sector median sales growth of 11.8% [E70]. However, that historical growth has abruptly stalled into a trailing twelve months contraction of -22% [E15], and earnings growth is actively decelerating [E62]. Furthermore, citing a massive 338% YoY sales surge [E58] ignores the reality that growth has violently reversed in the most recent period [E15]. The explosion in CWIP by 5892.9% to ₹ 8.39 Cr [E34] does not guarantee future returns; it represents an immense capital allocation risk for a company whose returns are already deeply depressed, registering an ROE of just 2.46% against a sector benchmark of 8.47% [E8]. Valuing this unproven execution at an exorbitant P/E of 90.38x—nearly five times the sector benchmark of 19.08x [E6]—with a 0.00% dividend yield [E4] and a stock sitting at a mere 9% of its 52-week range [E5], prices in perfection that the current contraction [E15] and lagging profitability [E8] simply do not support.
